slides.title: The same tint in Unreal HLSL

glsl:
vec3 base = texture(BaseTexture, UV).rgb;
vec3 color = base * Tint;

slides.title: Blend two colors with a mask

glsl:
float mask = smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, UV.x);
vec3 color = mix(ShadowColor, Tint, mask);
hlsl:
float mask = smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, UV.x);
return lerp(ShadowColor, Tint, mask);

glsl:
float edge = pow(1.0 - clamp(dot(normalize(N), normalize(V)), 0.0, 1.0), RimPower);
vec3 color = mix(Tint, EdgeColor, edge * EdgeStrength);
hlsl:
float edge = pow(1.0 - saturate(dot(normalize(N), normalize(V))), RimPower);
return lerp(Tint, EdgeColor, edge * EdgeStrength);
